Department of Health and Human Services.title: CDC FY2024 final program funding by operating-plan program
Department of Health and Human Services.basis: CDC's FY2024 operating plan publishes 13 additive top-level program controls plus EEOICPA, reconciling exactly to the $9.217495B CDC L/HHS total. These are final enacted program-funding amounts, not cash outlays, so this is a separate source-native view and is not additive to Treasury's $12.168B CDC net outlay.
rows: Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
HIV/AIDS, Viral Hepatitis, STI and TB Prevention
Birth Defects, Developmental Disabilities, Disability and Health
Energy Employees Occupational Illness Compensation Program Act
